answers.answer: Super Saturated hydration support in the retained final-stage representation comes from four source accounts. Initial-stage support includes A04 reporting strong hydration and desired before-makeup hydration, A08 reporting very hydrated skin while pairing Super Saturated with tretinoin and other actives, and A09 reporting combined Avant Guard use retaining hydration from Super Saturated. Later-stage added support includes A13 reporting hydration through a twelve-hour shift, nourishment of very dry cheeks, and moisture retention as a major routine benefit. The A09 account is counted because Super Saturated is part of the reported hydration routine, but it remains combined mask-plus-serum use and cannot be treated as isolated serum efficacy. Mask fit and rating deductions remain mask-only meanings.
limitations: No objective hydration measurement, prevalence, population claim, or causal strength is assigned.
A09 is co-use with Avant Guard, not isolated Super Saturated efficacy.
A13 includes source-owned skin conditions and personal attribution limits.

answers.answer: Super Saturated texture has three direct source accounts and one speculative comparison account. Direct texture accounts are A03, A04, and A13: A03 says Regimen Lab Wave Serum is less sticky than Super Saturated while continuing Super Saturated because of an uncertain glycerin belief; A04 reports Super Saturated as lightweight, refreshing, and quick-drying; A13 reports sticky, shiny, slick finish, perceived lower natural oil production, sometimes wearing one pump outside while accepting shine, and treating stickiness as an acceptable benefit tradeoff. The light/fast-drying and sticky/shiny/slick reports coexist as account-specific experiences. A17 is speculative only: the author had not tried Super Saturated and predicted Wave Serum would be thinner based on stated ingredient concentrations and humectants.
limitations: A03's ingredient reason is uncertain and does not make the firsthand stickiness comparison speculative.
A17 is not first-hand Experiment use and cannot establish actual texture.
No condition or dose resolves the disagreement across accounts.

answers.answer: Experiment action records show several completed or intended actions, kept separate from use, ownership, recommendations, and outcomes. Buying or stock-up is reported by A04, A05, and A11: A04 ordered Super Saturated after trying it through their sister, bought Buffer Jelly, then bought Plasma Wash, and immediately bought Molecular Mesh at launch; A05 immediately bought Avant Guard after creator discovery; A11 had three unopened Softwear tubes stocked during favorable months. A01 only re-added Softwear to a sale cart. A14 received Buffer Jelly free. A15 considered returning Plasma Wash but did not report completing a return. A16 intends routine replacement with Continuum, but this is a forecast that one Experiment product may replace separate azelaic-acid and salicylic-acid products, not a completed switch.
limitations: Quantities of tubes are not separate assertions.
Cart re-addition, gift receipt, considered return, intended replacement, and completed buying are separate action classes.
No purchase is inferred from use, ownership, recommendation, intention, or comparator acquisition.

product_action_assertions.basis: After sister introduction and loving Super Saturated, the reviewer ordered their own.
The reviewer bought Buffer Jelly seeking more nighttime hydration and repair.
The reviewer then bought Experiment's face wash, identified in the ledger as Plasma Wash by portfolio context.
The reviewer immediately bought Molecular Mesh when it launched; no use result is stated.
After discovering reusable Avant Guard through an unnamed TikTok creator, the reviewer bought it immediately.
The reviewer had three unopened Softwear tubes stocked during the months they loved it; quantity is not counted as multiple assertions.
After removing Softwear from a Friends and Family sale cart, a parent recommendation made the author put it back.
The reviewer received Buffer Jelly free for an honest review and posted after two uses.
Severe eye burning made the reviewer consider returning Plasma Wash.
The reviewer expects Continuum may replace separate azelaic-acid and salicylic-acid products to simplify their routine; this is future substitution, not a completed switch.
